answer: Cross-chain identity binding at the vote: each identity must lock collateral on two independent chains, and the plume of correlated deposits flags clones. The signal is a Merkle proof linking both stakes to one governance key; recycling stake across chains fails since timestamps interlock. A raven of 51% would need double the capital on both chains, so farming costs 2x per clone while voting power stays flat. Cost outruns payoff, so sybils starve.
